eras.name: Days of Thunder & First Flowering
eras.blurb: Sarrukh, batrachi and other creator races rise and vanish, dragons and giants contest the land, and the great elven realms flower before tearing themselves apart in the Crown Wars.

eras.name: Age of Netheril
eras.blurb: Fishing villages on the Narrow Sea grow into Netheril, whose arcanists raise flying enclaves on mythallars and dominate the North for three and a half millennia.

eras.name: Fall of Netheril & Successor Realms
eras.blurb: Karsus's Folly drops the enclaves from the sky; refugee states such as Halruaa, Anauroch's dwindling holdouts and the early Dales peoples pick up the pieces.

eras.name: Dalereckoning
eras.blurb: The Standing Stone seals the Dales Compact between humans and the elves of Cormanthyr, and its raising becomes year one of the common calendar; Cormyr is born soon after.

eras.name: Age of Myth Drannor
eras.blurb: Coronal Eltargrim's Opening turns the elven capital into Myth Drannor, a mythal-wrapped city where many races study magic together, until the Army of Darkness ends it.

eras.name: Age of Kingdoms
eras.blurb: Human realms spread across the Heartlands and Sword Coast: Zhentil Keep, Waterdeep under its Lords, the Moonsea cities and the Zhentarim all take shape in the late Age of Humanity.

eras.name: Era of Upheaval
eras.blurb: The Time of Troubles casts the gods down to walk Faerûn; the decades after bring the Tuigan Horde, the return of the Netherese shades and the Rage of Dragons.

eras.name: Spellplague Era
eras.blurb: Mystra's murder unravels the Weave in blue fire, swapping whole regions with Abeir and leaving a scarred, uncertain century of changed maps and broken magic.

eras.name: Second Sundering
eras.blurb: Ao rewrites the Tablets of Fate: Abeir and Toril separate again, Mystra and the Weave return, and the gods' Chosen fight a cascade of wars from the Silver Marches to Myth Drannor.

eras.name: Present Age
eras.blurb: With the Era of Upheaval declared over in 1489, the Sword Coast faces a run of crises: dragon cults, a death curse from Chult, Elturel's fall into Avernus and the Absolute.

events.title: Sarrukh empires arise
events.summary: The serpentine sarrukh found the first great realms of the Days of Thunder, including Isstosseffifil beneath what will become Anauroch. Their creations, among them the yuan-ti, outlive them by eons.

events.title: Crown Wars begin
events.summary: Aryvandaar's invasion of Miyeritar starts three millennia of elven civil war. The conflicts end with the Dark Disaster and the drow banished below the earth.

events.title: Cormanthyr founded
events.summary: Kahvoerm Irithyl draws the Rulers' Blade and becomes the first Coronal of the forest realm of Cormanthyr, the elven kingdom that will one day raise Myth Drannor.

events.title: Netheril founded
events.summary: Seven fishing villages on the Narrow Sea unite as the Alliance of Seventon, the seed of Netheril. Over centuries the discovery of the nether scrolls turns it into the greatest magocracy Faerûn has known.

events.title: Ched Nasad founded
events.summary: Drow exiles loyal to House Nasadra flee Menzoberranzan and begin weaving the City of Shimmering Webs across a deep chasm.

events.title: Karsus's Folly and the fall of Netheril
events.summary: The arcanist Karsus tries to seize Mystryl's divinity; magic briefly fails and the floating enclaves plunge from the sky. Thultanthar escapes destruction by slipping into the Plane of Shadow.

events.title: The Standing Stone and Dalereckoning
events.summary: Elves of Cormanthyr and human Dalesfolk raise the Standing Stone to seal their compact over settling the forest's edge. The year becomes the zero point of the Dalereckoning calendar.

events.title: Cormyr founded
events.summary: Faerlthann Obarskyr is crowned the first king of the Forest Kingdom, beginning a royal line that still holds the Dragon Throne in the 1490s.

events.title: The Opening of Myth Drannor
events.summary: After a dozen years of work a mythal is completed over the elven capital, now renamed Myth Drannor, and Coronal Eltargrim opens Cormanthyr to other races.

events.title: Weeping War: fall of Myth Drannor
events.summary: The Army of Darkness, a horde of fiends, undead and beasts, breaks the siege lines and overruns the City of Song. Survivors flee to Evermeet and the city becomes a haunted ruin for centuries.

events.title: Zhentil Keep fortified
events.summary: Sembian shipowner Orlephar Flostren hires workers and sellswords to fortify a site on the northern Moonsea, raising a keep over the trading camp that had stood there since c. 640.

events.title: Ascalhorn becomes Hellgate Keep
events.summary: Fiends summoned by Ascalhorn's own wizards overrun the city, and a bard's song renames its ruined fortress Hellgate Keep. The tanar'ri hold it for nearly five centuries.

events.title: Waterdeep's first Open Lord
events.summary: The wizard Ahghairon takes power from the warlord Rhaulor and becomes the first Lord of Waterdeep, turning a trading town into a true city; Northreckoning is counted from this year.

events.title: The Zhentarim founded
events.summary: Manshoon, newly master of Zhentil Keep, creates the Black Network to extend his reach along trade roads; the Banite Fzoul Chembryl joins him in 1263 and the network later takes Darkhold.

events.title: Pool of Radiance: Phlan reclaimed
events.summary: Adventurers clear the ruined city block by block and confront the possessing spirit Tyranthraxus beneath Valjevo Castle, letting the people of Phlan resettle their city.

events.title: Time of Troubles
events.summary: Ao casts the gods down into mortal avatars to find the stolen Tablets of Fate. Bane falls at Tantras, Bhaal at Boareskyr Bridge and Myrkul above Waterdeep, and Midnight rises as the new Mystra.

events.title: Bloodstone Wars end
events.summary: Gareth Dragonsbane and his companions slay the Witch-King Zhengyi at Castle Perilous, and Gareth is crowned king of a reunited Damara.

events.title: The Tuigan Horde invades
events.summary: Yamun Khahan's horsemen sweep out of the Hordelands through Shou Lung, Thay and Rashemen. In 1360 a western crusade under Azoun IV defeats them, and Azoun kills the Khahan in single combat.

events.title: Zhentil Keep shattered
events.summary: Strife between the followers of Cyric and the old Banite faith leaves most of Zhentil Keep in ruins; white dragons and frost giants assault what remains the next year.

events.title: Return of the Shades
events.summary: On the first day of the year the flying city of Thultanthar returns from the Plane of Shadow over Anauroch. Its shadovar princes break the phaerimm siege of Evereska and begin rebuilding Netheril.

events.title: Tilverton destroyed
events.summary: During the shadovar invasion of Cormyr, Vangerdahast's attempt to counter Shadow Weave magic goes wrong and blasts Tilverton into a crater later called the Tilverton Scar.

events.title: War of the Spider Queen: Ched Nasad falls
events.summary: While Lolth falls silent, a house feud fought with duergar stonefire brings the webbed city crashing into its own chasm. Few of its nearly 30,000 drow survive.

events.title: Rage of Dragons
events.summary: The lich Sammaster triggers a dragon frenzy across Faerûn that lasts a full year. When it ends, the Dracorage mythal is gone and the curse on dragonkind is broken for good.

events.title: Shadowstorm: Ordulin destroyed
events.summary: The Sharran priestess Elyril Hraven tears open a rift to the Plane of Shadow on the first of Nightal, and the Adumbral Calyx that pours out wipes Sembia's capital away. Months earlier fey'ri had toppled the Standing Stone.

events.title: Shadovar raze Zhentil Keep
events.summary: In the Shadowbane War the forces of Thultanthar destroy Zhentil Keep and the Citadel of the Raven alike.

events.title: The Spellplague
events.summary: Cyric, aided by Shar, murders Mystra, and the Weave ignites in blue fire. Halruaa, Lantan and Unther are carried off to Abeir, Mulhorand's capital is buried, the Sea of Fallen Stars drains and Evermeet withdraws into the Feywild.

events.title: The Companion rises over Elturel
events.summary: With the city overrun by its vampire High Rider's spawn, a second sun appears in the night and burns the undead to ash. The Companion never sets, and Elturgard is founded in its light.

events.title: Mount Hotenow erupts
events.summary: Meddling deep beneath the volcano rouses the primordial Maegera in Gauntlgrym, and the blast buries much of Neverwinter in ash and fire.

events.title: The Second Sundering
events.summary: Ao begins writing new Tablets of Fate, and over five years Abeir and Toril pull apart, lost lands return and the gods' Chosen clash across Faerûn.

events.title: War of the Silver Marches
events.summary: Driven by Lolth, drow of Menzoberranzan back the orcs of Many-Arrows against Luruar; Sundabar falls and is renamed Hartusk Keep. Bruenor unites the dwarven citadels and the orcs are broken by 1486.

events.title: Rage of Demons
events.summary: Matron Mother Quenthel Baenre calls demons into Menzoberranzan to cement her rule, and in 1486 Gromph Baenre's summoning lets Demogorgon and other demon lords loose in the Underdark.

events.title: Gauntlgrym reclaimed
events.summary: An army from Mithral Hall and Citadel Felbarr under Bruenor Battlehammer, Connerad Brawnanvil and Emerus Warcrown drives the drow out of the ancient Delzoun city.

events.title: Thultanthar crashes into Myth Drannor
events.summary: As the shadovar fight to seize the ruined city's mythal, Elminster brings the City of Shade down on Myth Drannor and both are leveled. The Sundering closes with Mystra and the Weave restored.

events.title: Tyranny of Dragons
events.summary: The Cult of the Dragon raids from Greenest north to the Well of Dragons, collecting a hoard and five dragon masks to free Tiamat from the Nine Hells. A Council of Waterdeep coalition stops her return.

events.title: Vorgansharax seizes Phlan
events.summary: The green dragon called the Maimed Virulence takes Phlan with cultist help and seals it inside a cage of thorns; refugees flee to Mulmaster.

events.title: Tomb of Annihilation: the death curse
events.summary: Acererak's Soulmonger in Chult traps the souls of the dead, so the resurrected waste away and no one can be raised. Adventurers trace it through Port Nyanzaru and Omu to the Tomb of the Nine Gods.

events.title: Descent into Avernus: Elturel taken
events.summary: The Companion turns black and drags all of Elturel into the first layer of the Nine Hells, payment on High Observer Thavius Kreeg's infernal pact. Refugees flood toward Baldur's Gate.

events.title: The Absolute at Baldur's Gate
events.summary: Tadpoles from a stolen elder brain bind a cult and the Chosen of the Dead Three into the Absolute, which moves to seize Baldur's Gate. The crisis is resolved in and below the city that same year.
